name: Pulse
tagline: A club for people who train seriously
niche: Fitness club: strength, functional and combat training

seo.title: Pulse — fitness club in Tashkent: gym and boxing
seo.description: An 1,800 m² gym, functional training, boxing and group programmes. Open 6:00 to 23:00, memberships from 590,000 UZS a month.
seo.answer: Pulse is a fitness club on Amir Temur in Tashkent: an 1,800 m² gym, a functional training zone, a ring and group programmes. Open daily from 6:00 to 23:00. Memberships from 590,000 UZS a month, a personal session is 250,000 UZS, and your first session with a coach is free.

listing.description: A website for a fitness club, sports studio or event. Neon on black, huge kinetic type that skews with scroll speed, memberships, coaches and a schedule.

sections.title: Faster. Stronger. Further.
sections.subtitle: 1,800 m² of iron, a ring, a functional zone and coaches who track your progress, not your sets.

sections.label: Programmes
sections.title: Choose your speed
sections.intro: Every programme is included in the Unlimited membership. Personal training is separate.

items.title: Gym
items.text: Free weights up to 60 kg, 9 power racks, a Hammer Strength line and a 40-station cardio zone.

items.title: Functional training
items.text: Groups of up to 12: strength, endurance and coordination in 50 minutes.

items.title: Boxing and kickboxing
items.text: A ring, 20 bags, coaches with national team experience. Beginners train in a separate group.

items.title: Personal training
items.text: A plan for your goal, nutrition tracking and measurements every four weeks.

items.title: Recovery
items.text: A Finnish sauna, a hammam and a massage therapist by appointment.

items.name: Daytime
features: An intro session with a coach

items.quote: In six months with Rustam my bench went from 70 to 110 kg. Most importantly, no injuries: technique is drilled from the first session.
items.author: Azamat

items.quote: I came for a trial functional class and stayed. The groups are small and the coach sees everyone.
items.author: Kamila

items.quote: I go at 6 a.m. before work — the gym is empty, everything is clean, and the coffee at the bar is ready.
items.author: Dmitry

items.a: Daytime (until 17:00) is 590,000 UZS a month, Unlimited 790,000 UZS, and the annual 6,900,000 UZS. A single visit is 120,000 UZS.
Yes, your first session with a coach is free: a club tour, measurements and a plan for the first month. Book by phone or on Telegram.
Every day from 6:00 to 23:00, holidays included. Group classes run on schedule from 7:00 to 21:00.

items.q: How much is a personal trainer?
items.a: One session is 250,000 UZS, a pack of 10 is 2,200,000 UZS. You can choose or change your coach at any time.
Yes: monthly memberships for up to 7 days, annual for up to 60 days a year, by request at reception.

items.q: Do I need my own kit and towel?
items.a: Just your kit and indoor shoes. Towels, lockers and showers are included in every membership.

sections.label: Start
sections.title: Your first session is on us
sections.text: Leave a request — our front desk will call back within 15 minutes and find you a time.
